text:
sam: Kickoff: deploying runtime v2.14, api v3.2, router v1.9 to prod in the 01:00-02:30 UTC change window. Need release notes + pin plan + decision on extending window to 90m. Canary -> ramp -> full. Any blockers?

deploy-bot: DRY-RUN: all services pass config validation. Suggested canary groups: runtime (5%), api (5%), router (5%). No collisions. Command preview:
```
deploy --services runtime:2.14,api:3.2,router:1.9 --canary 5% --window 90m --auto-rollback "5xx>1%:5m"
```
No real deploy performed.

ina: Heads up — we have a DB migration overlapping at 01:15 for ~10m. Can we shift start to 01:30 instead? That would require extending window to 120m. Also console has a tiny UI tweak that depends on api:3.2; request to pin console to v1.1 during migration.

jamie: Release notes draft (prod channel): "runtime v2.14: KV eviction perf fix; runtime API: improved streaming stability; router v1.9: reduced connection churn." Draft link: https://go/release-notes/draft-2812 

priya: Rollback criteria proposal: if canary 5xx > 1% OR token-p95 latency regresses >30% => auto-rollback. Also: how long do we keep console pinned to v1.1 if required? Need a TTL.

lee: Router requires runtime flag `runtime.kv_compat=false` to enable the new eviction path. That flag is not in prod config yet. If we flip it we must ensure api 3.2 has the backward-compat shim enabled. Need QA signoff before flipping.

marco: My staging run suggests: canary 5% for 10m, ramp to 50% over 30m, then 100% over 15m. Auto-rollback triggers: 5xx >1% sustained for 5m OR p95 latency up >30% for 10m. Also add a manual pin fallback for console to revert if UI errors surface.

deploy-bot: CHECK: runtime flag missing -> prod config lacks `runtime.kv_compat=false`. Dry-run will only pass after `cfg set runtime kv_compat false`. Also noted console pin annotation required: `pin console v1.1 until 2026-03-21T04:00Z`.

sam: I'll apply the config patch and create the pin now. @deploy-bot please run a second dry-run after patch.

deploy-bot: DRY-RUN 2: config patch applied, validations pass, canary groups scheduled. Reminder: update release notes to include the `kv_compat` flip and list rollback contacts.

ina: Approved for window extension to 120m due to DB migration. We start at 01:30 UTC. :thumbsup: 

priya: Added rollback contacts to the release notes: @sam @lee @marco @ops-oncall

jamie: QA: I'll run the post-canary smoke tests and report back. If green, I'll post "GO" within the first 15m of canary.

sam: Ack. Launching at 01:30 UTC. Final checklist for ops: deploy-bot command in ops-runbook, release-notes link in product channel, console pin annotated in config. Good luck team.
